stages.label: CURIOUS
stages.description: Begin with a question worth staying with.

stages.label: LEARN
stages.description: Find language, tools, and people to go further.

stages.label: BUILD
stages.description: Give an idea a form that can be tested.

stages.label: TEST
stages.description: Meet the constraints that make the work stronger.

stages.label: PITCH
stages.description: Put the work in front of someone else.

stages.label: LEAD
stages.description: Carry the idea with and for other people.

stages.label: LAUNCH
stages.description: Take the next step beyond the room.
